titleEn: Kitchen Renovation Costs in BC: 2026 Guide by Reno Stars
titleZh: BC省厨房装修费用指南：聚星装修2026版
contentEn:
Reno Stars has completed over 200 kitchen renovations across Metro Vancouver since 2015. This guide covers real material and labour costs for kitchen renovation projects in British Columbia in 2026, drawn from our actual project data and publicly available construction cost indices.

What Does a Kitchen Renovation Cost in BC in 2026?

The average mid-range kitchen renovation in Metro Vancouver costs between $35,000 and $85,000 in 2026, according to Reno Stars' completed project records. A luxury custom kitchen with high-end appliances, stone countertops, and custom cabinetry can exceed $150,000. Budget renovations that replace cabinets, countertops, and flooring without altering the layout typically start at $18,000.

These prices reflect current material costs including cabinetry, countertops, plumbing fixtures, electrical upgrades, and labour. They do not include structural changes, moving gas or plumbing rough-ins, or permits where required.

Cost Breakdown by Kitchen Component

The single largest expense in any kitchen renovation is cabinetry, typically consuming 30–40% of the total budget. Here is how the major cost categories typically divide:

  • Custom or semi-custom cabinetry: $12,000–$45,000 depending on layout size and material
  • Countertops (quartz, granite, or solid surface): $3,500–$12,000
  • Appliances (fridge, stove, dishwasher, range hood): $4,000–$15,000
  • Electrical upgrades (outlets, lighting, panel upgrades): $2,000–$7,500
  • Plumbing fixtures and rough-in adjustments: $1,500–$5,000
  • Flooring (hardwood, tile, or luxury vinyl): $2,500–$8,000
  • Labour and installation: $8,000–$25,000 depending on scope
  • Permits and inspections (where applicable): $500–$2,500

Kitchen Renovation Costs by City in Metro Vancouver

Labour and material costs vary by city based on permit requirements, accessibility, and local contractor availability:

  • Vancouver: $40,000–$95,000 average. Higher labour costs and permit fees reflect city-specific requirements.
  • Richmond: $35,000–$85,000 average. Strong new-home demand keeps renovation activity high.
  • Burnaby: $33,000–$80,000 average. Mix of older homes and new developments creates steady renovation demand.
  • North Vancouver / West Vancouver: $45,000–$110,000 average. Larger project scale and higher material specifications.
  • Coquitlam / Port Coquitlam: $30,000–$75,000 average. Newer home stock with standard layouts reduces retrofit costs.
  • Delta / Surrey: $28,000–$70,000 average. Lower labour and land costs compared to Vancouver proper.

What Factors Affect Kitchen Renovation Cost?

Layout changes are the biggest cost variable. Moving a sink, stove, or island requires new drainage, water supply runs, and often electrical re-wiring. Each major move adds $3,000–$8,000. Keeping the existing layout and replacing only surfaces is the most cost-effective approach.

How Long Does a Kitchen Renovation Take?

A typical mid-range kitchen renovation in Metro Vancouver takes 8–14 weeks from demolition to final inspection. Luxury or layout-change projects can extend to 16–24 weeks. The more custom the cabinetry, the longer the lead time (typically 4–8 weeks for cabinet fabrication and delivery).

How to Budget for a Kitchen Renovation

  • Set aside 10–15% of your total budget as contingency, particularly for post-war homes where hidden structural issues or outdated wiring are common.
  • Prioritize cabinet quality — cabinets are the visual centrepiece of the kitchen and are hardest to replace after installation.
  • Consider phased upgrades: do the layout, cabinetry, and countertops in one project; upgrade appliances separately later.

自2015年以来，聚星装修已在温哥华地区完成了超过200个厨房装修项目。本指南基于我们的实际项目数据，涵盖2026年不列颠哥伦比亚省厨房装修的真实材料与人工成本。

2026年BC省厨房装修费用是多少？

根据聚星装修已完成项目记录，2026年大温哥华地区中档厨房装修平均费用在35,000至85,000加元之间。配备高端电器、石英石台面和定制橱柜的豪华定制厨房可能超过150,000加元。仅更换橱柜、台面和地板而不改变布局的经济型装修通常从18,000加元起。

厨房装修费用明细

橱柜是每个厨房装修中最大的开支，通常占总预算的30%至40%。主要成本分类如下：

  • 定制或半定制橱柜：根据布局大小和材料，$12,000至$45,000
  • 台面（石英石、花岗岩或实心表面）：$3,500至$12,000
  • 电器（冰箱、炉灶，洗碗机、抽油烟机）：$4,000至$15,000
  • 电气升级（插座、照明、配电箱升级）：$2,000至$7,500
  • 管道装置和粗调调整：$1,500至$5,000
  • 地板（硬木、瓷砖或豪华乙烯基）：$2,500至$8,000
  • 人工和安装：根据工程范围，$8,000至$25,000
  • 许可和检查（如适用）：$500至$2,500

大温哥华各城市厨房装修费用

基于聚星装修的项目记录，各城市的劳动力和材料成本存在差异：

  • 温哥华：平均$40,000至$95,000。较高的劳动力成本和许可费用反映了城市特定要求。
  • 列治文：平均$35,000至$85,000。新建住宅需求旺盛，装修活动持续活跃。
  • 本拿比：平均$33,000至$80,000。老旧住宅与新开发项目并存，装修需求稳定。
  • 北温/西温：平均$45,000至$110,000。项目规模较大，材料规格更高。
  • 高贵林/Port Coquitlam：平均$30,000至$75,000。新建住宅比例高，标准布局降低改造成本。
  • 三角洲/萨里：平均$28,000至$70,000。与温哥华相比，劳动力和土地成本较低。

哪些因素影响厨房装修费用？

布局变化是最大的成本变量。移动水槽、炉灶或岛台需要重新铺设排水管、供水管，通常还需要重新布线。每个主要移动项目增加$3,000至$8,000的成本。保持现有布局仅更换表面是最具成本效益的方式。

厨房装修需要多长时间？

大温哥华地区典型的中档厨房装修从拆除到最终检查通常需要8至14周。豪华或涉及布局变化的项目可能延长至16至24周。橱柜的定制度越高，交付周期越长（通常4至8周的备货时间）。

如何为厨房装修做预算？

  • 预留总预算10%至15%作为应急资金，特别是对于战后住宅，隐藏的结构问题或过时布线很常见。
  • 优先考虑橱柜质量——橱柜是厨房的视觉中心，安装后最难更换。
  • 考虑分阶段升级：将布局、橱柜和台面放在一个项目完成；电器等以后单独升级。
